items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: And I met up with Buddy Tate up in New York... And Milton Larkins, and I said, man, let's march these cats around the place.

ctx.x: No lanyard. No, they don't know what the hell, what that is. No, no second line? No, no, no, no. You didn't read the little article about the second line. I was telling Segura yesterday that people are alike all over. And I met up with Buddy Tate up in New York, and I was on one of my visits up there. And Milton Larkins, and I said, man, let's march these cats around the place. He said, man, they don't know nothing about that up here. Yeah. I said, okay, watch me. Yeah. So I got to playing, and I dug a cat in the…
The third reel of Don Albert, September 18, 1972. We were talking about Buddy Tate, you were up there in New York. You were sitting in or something and you guys started dancing?
